title.narrative: Taller "Construyendo igualdad desde la comunidad educativa del nivel inicial"

description.narrative:
Se apunta a orientar a los actores educativos del Nivel Inicial sobre el manejo y ejercicio del concepto "sujetos plenos de derechos", además se pretende proveer herramientas para implementar estrategias con cuidadores y familias en la dimensión educativa y sistematizar las experiencias de la práctica en las diferentes comunidades educativas. La propuesta se realizará mediante talleres dirigidos a actores de la comunidad educativa del nivel inicial y para relevar la experiencia respecto al cumplimiento de los derechos en las familias con niños de nivel inicial.
(ENG) The aim is to guide the educational actors of the Initial Level on the management and exercise of the concept of "full subjects of rights", in addition to providing tools to implement strategies with caregivers and families in the educational dimension and systematize the experiences of the practice in the different educational communities. The proposal will be carried out through workshops aimed at actors of the educational community of the initial level and to survey the experience regarding the fulfillment of rights in families with children at the initial level.It aims to guide the educational actors of the Initial Level on the management and exercise of the concept "full subjects of rights", in addition it is intended to provide tools to implement strategies with caregivers and families in the educational dimension and to systematize the experiences of the practice in the different educational communities.
